So the guide (yarn install, yarn dev) cannot fully produce a working app because required data files depend on credentials not mentioned in the guide. This is an installation-completeness failure: pages 500.

Let me do a final confirmation of a representative set of routes and capture exact evidence. Also confirm root works but navigation likely references broken routes. The app is partially operational: homepage OK, category pages (the core dashboard) broken.

Let me also verify there are no other missing imports, e.g. check all imports from assets/data exist.

Let me run a check for all `@/assets/data/` imports and see which are missing.
